Data source. A categorical analysis compared the rsp values from 
the EEO data (7 effects, all using verbal fluency measures) with 
the 11 other effects. The mean rsp value for the 7 effects using 
EEO data was positive, with a value of .038 (SE = .026) and a 
95% CI from –.013 to .088 under the mixed-effects model. The 
weighted mean for the 11 other studies was .002 (SE = .005), 
with a 95% CI from −.008 to .012, and the results were homo-
geneous. Neither mean differed significantly from zero. An initial 
fixed-effects test of between-groups differences, QBetween(1) = 
31.33, p < .05, R2Meta = .67, indicated that this moderator 
explained significant amounts of variability among the effects. 
However, the difference between the two sets of effects disap-
peared when the additional unexplained variation in the set of 
effects based on the EEO data was incorporated into the analysis 
(z = 1.43, p = .15).
